text:
Lena: Quick thread to finalize private-alpha recruitment rubric, onboarding slots, and feedback tempo. Need final sign-offs by EOD so CS can start outreach.

Omar: Suggest cap 7 partners: 5 sandbox, 2 deep-integration. Keep integrations low friction.

Priya: I'll own partner comms + welcome packet. Propose 3-week active window instead of 4 to keep momentum high.

Ken: Eng constraints: one integration dev day each, plus 3 small telemetry hooks. Hosted-first is best.

Ravi: Legal: integrations require NDA+DPA, ~2 business days. Mark that in calendar.

Lena: Rubric idea (simple): score 1-5 on fit, ability to commit, infra compatibility, and clarity of metrics. Weight fit=40%, commit=30%, infra=20%, metrics=10%.

Omar: +1. Add a quick exclusion rule: if infra requires on-prem or dedicated networking, exclude from alpha.

Priya: Outreach copy (short):
"Hi <partner>, we'd love to invite you to Redwood private alpha. Commitment: 3 weeks, weekly 30m sync, brief async reports. Reply with track: sandbox or integration.
Thanks! —Priya & Lena"

Ken: Telemetry minimal events: prompt_id, response_ms, variant, feedback_flag. Sample line (JSON): `{"event":"response_ms","value":180,"route":"/v1/chat"}`

Lena: Feedback cadence: weekly 30m check-ins + one mid-run survey (5 questions) + Looms for critical failures. Priya to collect Looms in shared folder.

Ravi: Incentives: $500 credits + priority roadmap consideration for integrations. Keep cash minimal.

Omar: Success gates (pass/fail): onboarding >75% in 48h, weekly active sessions >=2, and at least two actionable tickets per partner by end.

Ken: Operational trigger: any partner reporting >20% latency regression or spike in 5xxs -> auto-page eng oncall.

Priya: I'll draft invite list (12 targets) and run scoring next Mon. Will include acceptance SLA: confirm within 72 hours.

Lena: Action items: Priya: final invite + packet by Fri; Ken: telemetry stub + 1-page runbook by Thu; Omar: shortlist + initial scores by Mon; Ravi: NDA two-pager today.

alpha-bot: Calendar created: "Private Alpha kickoff" Mon 09:30 PST (owner: Lena).

Priya: small note: prefer to run two onboarding slots per week to keep pace and handle timezones.

Lena: Agreed. Thanks team — will publish doc and tag owners when done. Flag any objections now.
